e: Decapitalization, from planet Jupiter. From being a planet like Jupiter.
From Middle English jupe, from Middle French jupe. Doublet of jubbah.
Apparently named after an EFnet user called Jupiter who did this to NickServ
q: [T]he people all wore hosen and shoon and smocks and jupes and jerkins and wimples.

e: Borrowed from Middle English jupoun, jupon, from Middle French jupon. Doublet of żupan.
q: 1700, John Dryden, Palamon and Arcite, Book III:
He climbed three marble steps, crossed the terrace and entered a dim foyer, where a chamberlain silently helped him from his helmet, his jupon and his chain cuirass.
